title: Hyper Automation
description: Hyper Automation is a modpack with mods that focus on automating tasks like mining, processing ore, and harvesting crops.
body:
Hyper Automation is a modpack with a primary focus on Create Mod. This modpack is primarially for people who like to automate things and build crazy machines, but it also has some other cool mods that add their own fun to the game such as:

- Tinker's Construct: Hammers and other 3x3 tools
- Dank Storage: Large portible storage containers
- Mekanism: Better ore processing and many other fun machines.
- Micro Teleporters: Teleport between various locations.

The full mod list is:

- Create Mod
- Mekanism
- Mekanism Generaters
- Tinker's Construct
- Mantle
- Dank Storage
- Jade
- JEI
- Micro Teleporters
